text: Pilot hypothesis: production change-request and decision-rights graph
description: Represent cross-department change requests, dependencies, affected goals, accountable owner, deadline, and explicit approval state. Agents detect conflicts, summarize impact, and chase missing information; humans retain authority for safety, budget, staffing, permits, artist commitments, and final go/no-go decisions. Measure coordination latency, duplicate/conflicting work, decisions lacking an owner, and emergency escalations. Valuable but higher-risk; test only in shadow mode before any live use.

status.comment: Workflow hypothesis awaiting operator evidence; do not build before validating real pain, ownership, artifacts, baseline, and willingness to pay.
